svg.title: All54 Loop Current composite contour and gateway cases
svg.desc: Two rows show positive and negative surface composites; three columns show absolute ADT levels0.50,0.55,0.60m. Each panel retains all nine editorial gateway shifts. Black central-gate contours over white outlines, white sensitivity paths, dashed red rejected components and orange gateways. All54cases have one supported open arc. Nominal0.55m paths are about1400km positive and600km negative. These are geometry of conditional composites, not mean daily lengths, annual extrema, ranked whole-current lengths or physical widths. Exact paths, rejected components and every velocity sample are in the checked composite-contour report.
